verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an AI assistant and model service, so the axis applies. However, every first-party item describes hosted use: logging in to the Kimi Code platform, API keys in the Kimi console, and the hosted API at api.moonshot.ai. Community remarks calling K3 "open-weight" or "open source" are passing comments, not documented self-hosting of the core product, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
